description: Deterministic client-side guardrails (fail-open): refuse dangerous Bash (rm -rf of a root, force-push to main/master, manual `argocd app sync/rollback/patch/set`, `kubectl delete namespace`, `curl|sh`, `git add CLAUDE.md`), refuse writing secret material / vendored helm charts/ / in-repo CLAUDE.md, and run an advisory plain-YAML syntax check after edits.
